cases.finding: A bounded native MPEG-TS parser existed, but its extracted elementary stream and original-byte mappings did not enter the retained file workflow.
cases.resolution: Bind parser-owned selection and all limits in a compact extraction receipt, retain complete original TS plus a canonical origin proof and native AU/capsule map, then reuse existing retained AVC/HEVC readers and decoders.

cases.finding: Holding the planning journal stabilizes grants and witnesses, but does not stop time advancing during source checks or network preparation.
cases.resolution: Retain clock mode/root and monotonic watermark, persist consequential admission and exact expiry, and carry a deny-only live callback plus the fixed session ceiling into native Commit/Send admission.

cases.finding: Initial source-loop draft charged actual returned bytes after I/O.
cases.resolution: Reserve each bounded requested read before I/O, retain short/failure/EOF debits, and carry one cumulative owner through parse, preparation and publication.

findings: Finite TS import preserves unselected audio, exact duplicate packets, headers and all original bytes; it never repairs damaged visible custody from the loose source.
PES boundaries and raw wrapping PTS/DTS are not decoded-picture or capture-time evidence. Native AU splitting and the existing decoder's supported profile remain separate.
Capture time remains unknown or an explicit existing operator assumption; finite file imports do not establish live continuity or absence.

Source verification reconstructs under intersected current/historical container limits. Retained read caches preserve exact proof identity and current erasure checks but do not continuously certify on-disk bytes already cached.
Session expiry narrows new network activity without renewing authority. Existing finite receipt/custody cleanup and no-resend reporting remain under their original owners.
Four new import digest domains, three stable errors and the adapter registry v4 are registered; historical adapter digest pins remain unchanged.
No dependency, toolchain, codec runtime, credential scope, public operation registry or release gate was weakened.

budgets.transport: Separate 64 MiB original and elementary ceilings; independent packet, PSI, PES, PES-byte and mapping bounds.
budgets.retained: At most 65,536 native AUs and original chunks; proof at most 4 MiB; first range replays original custody and caches one verified elementary stream.
budgets.operator: One cancellable coarse work reservation, default 1 GiB/max 4 GiB; original and reconstructed limits may be narrowed independently.
budgets.session: Original fixed expiry, grants and native cleanup deadline remain nonrenewing.
